name: W Istanbul
insider_take: Where the ancient meets the avant-garde — W Istanbul brings bold, boundary-pushing luxury to the heart of one of the world's most storied cities.
whats_special: Housed in a beautifully restored 19th-century Ottoman townhouse in the historic Beşiktaş district, W Istanbul blends centuries of history with signature W Hotels' irreverent style. Perched along the European shores of the Bosphorus, the hotel offers jaw-dropping strait views and sits just minutes from iconic landmarks like Dolmabahçe Palace and Taksim Square. The hotel's WET® deck and rooftop terrace are legendary among Istanbul's jet-set crowd, and its WOOBAR® pulses nightly with the city's vibrant social scene.
pro_tip: Request a Bosphorus-facing room for sunrise views that are simply unmatched — watching the morning light ripple across the strait with two continents in sight is a once-in-a-lifetime experience you won't want to miss.
dont_miss: Sip handcrafted cocktails at WOOBAR® while watching the sun dip behind the European skyline, explore the vibrant Beşiktaş street market just steps away, and indulge in a traditional hammam experience at the hotel's signature spa — a perfect fusion of Ottoman ritual and modern wellness.
pros: Prime Akaretler location in upscale Besiktas district
Stunning Bosphorus views from select rooms and rooftop
Vibrant nightlife scene with rooftop bar W Lounge
Modern luxury design with signature W style amenities
cons: Party-focused atmosphere may not suit all travelers
